frontmatter.title: Data Engineering Intern
frontmatter.company: JSS Academy of Higher Education & Research

node.html:
• Extracted and integrated data from 2 enterprise systems (university and hospital) across 3–5 structured datasets, supporting research and operational pipelines within the Division of Research, Academics, and IT
  • Cleaned and standardised healthcare datasets from an 1,800-bed tertiary hospital (18,000+ inpatients/month), improving data consistency and reliability across clinical and academic domains
  • Developed and maintained structured databases using Python, SQL and dbt, storing and managing data on AWS S3 and EC2 to support both operational workflows and research purposes
  • Contributed to the end-to-end delivery of a Learning Management System (LMS), troubleshooting data quality issues across departments while working independently in a regulated healthcare environment

• Built BigQuery KPI tables/views and standardised weekly reporting workflows used in cross-functional reviews
  • Created reusable SQL models for 10+ reports; reduced duplicate cleaning by ~70%
  • Built KPI dashboards for 8+ stakeholders and automated reporting with Python, cutting effort significantly
  • Tools used: SQL, BigQuery, Python, Power BI, Tableau

• Built weekly cohort-style summaries tracking retention/churn signals (returning users, repeat conversions) by channel
  • Analysed funnel drop-offs (landing signup conversion) and flagged steps with the highest abandonment
  • Segmented performance by campaign/creative/landing page; shared insights to improve conversion quality
  • Created KPI dashboards (spend, CTR, conversions) and presented weekly updates for stakeholder decisions
  • Tools used: GA4, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Excel/Google Sheets, Google Slides
